results.name: Lemon Tart
results.description: This lemon tart 3D scan was processed using using object masking in PhotoCatch on an M2 MacBook Air. To capture the base of the tart, I had to hold it up while taking phots. PhotoCatch did such an amazing job to mask out my hand, although there are still some gaps in the mesh.

results.name: Lemon
results.description:
The lemon is based on a photogrammetry scan and was reworked by the following steps:
  • manual retopo
  • clean and packed UV map
  • baked textures from photogrammetry scan on manual retopo
The model contains a 2K texture for
  • baseColor
  • normal
  • roughness
The lemon is also part of the pack [fruit bowl](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fruitbowl-d89f6311cb0c4c37b0bf9cdd1e5abcb3).
